title: Is This World War III?
summary: An investment commentator and his host argue the US is to blame for the conflict with Iran, that the world is heading into another world war as in the 1930s, and that fights over shipping chokepoints will draw more countries in.

assertions.quote: We're on the way to World War II. There's no question about it.

verdicts.note: There has been no great-power war since 1945, and forecasters put one over the next decade well under even odds.
The Metaculus community gives a third world war only a 22% chance before 2050, the opposite of inevitable over the next quarter-century.
Clauset estimates about a 43% chance of a WWII-sized war over the next 100 years under a constant hazard: not a small risk, but far from certain.
Metaculus forecasters put World War III before 2050 at 22% (3.3k forecasters) and, conditional on AGI arriving, at 4% within five years of it (66 forecasters): far from inevitable.

assertions.quote: it's exactly analogous to what happened before World War II

verdicts.note: A historical analogy, a way of framing events rather than a testable claim.

assertions.quote: No, I don't. I think it's hysteria on Trump's part.

verdicts.note: Iran has no known nuclear weapon, and such an attack would invite devastating retaliation.

assertions.quote: the US uh conducted a coup to replace him with the sha

verdicts.note: The 1953 coup is a documented root of Iranian grievance, but the 1979 revolution, the hostage crisis and later proxy wars drive the hostility too.

assertions.quote: it's going to draw in more and more players who are dependent upon it

verdicts.note: Attacks on shipping have drawn in European and Asian navies before, as in the Red Sea in 2024, but mostly as escorts rather than combatants.

assertions.quote: the Saudi government will be overthrown and that will create chaos

verdicts.note: The Saudi monarchy has a long record of stability and there is no sign of an imminent revolt.
